<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Feign Madness but Keep Your Balance</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
Sun Bin's former classmate Pang Juan (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">庞涓</span></span>,
died 342 B.C.) was secretly jealous of him for surpassing him as a
military strategist, and so framed him for treason and reported him
to King Hui (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">魏惠王</span></span>,
400–319 B.C.) of Wei. Believing these charges, the King was
furious, and ordered that Sun Bin be executed. Pang Juan pretended,
asking the king to spare his life, and the King agreed and condemned
Sun Bin to a life of tattooing the faces of criminals (criminal
branding), and had him crippled by removing his kneecaps. Pretending
again to take pity on Sun Bin, Pang Juan tried tricking him into
compiling his military knowledge into a book, and planned to kill him
afterward. Some servants, though, knew the truth of Pang Juan's
intentions, and told this to Sun Bin. Sun Bin then pretended to have
gone mad. This caused Pang Juan to lose interest in killing him, and
Sun Bin was able to escape from Wei to the State of Qi, where he
eventually became a renowned military strategist and statesman [17].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Feign
Madness But Keep Your Balance</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
can be associated with the third hexagram, <i>Water
over Thunder</i>, which
symbolizes danger or chaos at the beginning of an enterprise. The
yang line at the very bottom wants to move upward, but is held down
by the yin lines of the Water trigram. One interpretation suggests
that this initial chaos should not be rushed into, or, a situation
where making an advancement might require hiding one's true
intentions [1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: small;"></span>

LIST 27:</b></span></span></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section79" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不同的机械师用不同的工具。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Different mechanics
	use different tools.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在中国，进去别人家里的时候，要把鞋子</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;脱下来换拖鞋。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: In China, when
	entering into other people’s houses, you should take off your
	shoes and change into slippers.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有一些武器是金属和塑料做的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)&nbsp;</span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-family: times;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他昨天告诉你的事是假的。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">5)&nbsp;</span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-family: times;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他痴迷于植物学，像要癫狂了一样。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我把台灯打开的时候，在空气里看</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;灰。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有太阳，你为什么戴太阳镜？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在中国，有地毯的房子很少。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他忘记把裤子拉链拉起来了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他是这个专业的专家，但是他不会中</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;文，所以不能沟通。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11)  Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个伤口怎么弄的？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我昨天摔倒，受伤了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我外套上的一些纽扣丢了，所以扣不起</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;来了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">13) Q:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">枕头怎么被弄湿了？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我洗澡以后，把毛巾忘在枕头上</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: trebuchet;"><span lang="en-US">14</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span>
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">请把电脑关机。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
-------------------------------------</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-26-point-at.html">Previous Chapter</a> <br /></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/04/notes-from-china-chapter-28-remove.html">Next Chapter</a><br /></p>
